gaps.expected: The accepted AD-08 Retention design (PPO-AD08-RETENTION-FIGMA-DEC) uses grid registers grouped by status for policies, holds, requests and runs, a per-system outcome grid on the request record, and a record banner reading "On hold: deletion suspended". The outcome rows and the banner are page-only Figma parts built from Grid / Cell and frames.
gaps.actual: /admin/retention is not built, and no component was added to the Figma Components page. Other pages that hold affected records don't show the banner.
gaps.action: When a build is requested, adopt the shared register table for AD-08 and record any departure. Create a shared part for the banner only when a second page takes it.
